text:
Maya Chen: Quick proposal — narrow Optimize toolkit v1 to a 'golden path' for pilot customers. Scope: batching heuristics (adaptive window + prefix caching) + eval-triggered alerts (regressions on prompt sets). Exclude quant recommendations for now; move to v1.1. Goal: ship within next sprint. Thoughts?

Danielle Rivera: I like narrower scope. Need concrete launch criteria. What acceptance metrics do we need for econ & reliability?

Ajay Patel: From runtime side — batching + prefix KV caching is straightforward. Key risk: autoscaling + admission control with adaptive batching. Quant recs need model eval infra; that's a bigger lift.

Leo Wong: Customer econ signal: target 20–30% per-token cost reduction for common batchable workloads. Acceptance: stable p50/p95 latency under current SLO, and observed cost improvement >=15% on pilot corpora. Also define FP rate for eval alerts.

Sasha Kumar: Customer asks: two pilots (AcmeHealth, NoteFlow) want quant recs ASAP. Can we offer advisory docs as interim? They'll accept 'recommended config' if we make it clear it's experimental.

Maya Chen: Yes — offer a one-page advisory for quantization as a stopgap. Keep it out of the core runtime. We'll prioritize infra that'll unblock quant when we have bandwidth.

Danielle Rivera: Proposed launch gates: 1) end-to-end bench with representative prompt sets, 2) alerting tuned to <5% noise on evals, 3) config UI slice for enabling/disabling batching per-route, 4) docs & playbook for pilot onboarding.

Ajay Patel: Implementation note — for adaptive batching, we need an admission control rule set:`
```json
{"max_batch_ms": 20, "min_batch_size": 4, "cost_threshold_usd": 0.0003}
```
We'll test with synthetic traces first.

ops-bot: Deploy note — canary pool for Optimize-slice created in us-west-2, capacity 3x baseline. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

Leo Wong: Suggest adding an econ acceptance: measured delta on pilot usage within first 72 hours >= 10% reduction vs baseline. If not met, automatic rollback policy.

Sasha Kumar: I'll take lead on customer comms and draft the advisory doc for quant recs. ETA EOD Thu.

Maya Chen: OK — decision: narrow MVP to batching + cache + eval-alerts; advisory quant docs for pilots. Action items: Ajay infra spike (this week), Danielle acceptance checklist, Sasha customer comms, Leo measurement dashboards. :thumbsup:
